find:
if (entering || exiting) return; // resolved when the change in flight lands
  if (!rootNative()
replace:
if (entering || exiting) { mine = false; return; } // resolved when the change in flight lands
  if (!rootNative()
note: Exit while the native request is in flight disowns it (the round-3 race): the request lands with expanded off and is kept, so a double press on Expand (or F F) leaves the page in native fullscreen while expanded is off. Only S-FRAME's nativeRace, with requestFullscreen slowed by 300 ms, presses inside that window (design spec 4.7, E-B5).
